source.name: Pastel Veil
source.originalDescription: The Pokémon's psychic counter charges based on the distance they run (up to 10 times). When the counter is full, the Pokémon is granted a shield, becoming hindrance resistant while the shield remains. When the Pokémon reaches an additional movement speed threshold, the damage dealt by moves is increased by 5/20/35/50/60%. The increased damage based on movement speed is calculated before dealing damage with moves.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Pastel Veil は 与ダメージを変化させる、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。

source.name: Triad Blitz
source.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and charges at the designated opposing Pokémon, shoving opposing Pokémon in the way and stunning them for 0.8s when hit. When the charge ends, a mysterious triangular space is created around the designated opposing Pokémon if the user hits them. That Pokémon cannot leave that space. When the mysterious space is created, this move can be used again up to 3 times within 5.5s. With each additional use, the user runs at high speed forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path. If the path of a dash starts or ends in the mysterious space, this move can be used again immediately afterward. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Triad Blitz は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
